feats.name: Rapid Fire
feats.description: Once a turn, you can fire twice at a target with a -3 to Hit.

feats.name: Biggest Booms
feats.description: your grenades + rockets can now crit (+3 crit dmg).

feats.name: Combat Engineer
feats.description: double the effect of sapper.

feats.name: Sting Grenades
feats.description: flashbangs have a 50% to stun instead of disorient.

feats.name: Iron Curtain
feats.description: make an attack action for 1/2 dmg + for targets Hit suffer a -1/2 mov for 2 turns, Uses 3 ammo, 10 ft cone.

feats.name: Bring 'Em Down
feats.description: +1 crit dmg for every 2 enemies, up to 8.

feats.name: Deadeye
feats.description: you can take a shot as an attack action with a -3 to Hit + at +10 dmg, 3 Turn cooldown.

feats.name: Vital Point Targeting
feats.description: Attacks vs tagged targets take +1 (+2 if tag) more dmg.

feats.name: Disabling Shot
feats.description: as an action, attack a target + if you Hit, Stun them for 2 turns + another 2 turns if you crit (+crit dmg), 5 turn cooldown.

feats.name: Reaper
feats.description: as a bonus action, your first melee attack will Hit. if you Kill, your movement & main action is refreshed, each consecutive attack -3 dmg, 4 turn cooldown.

feats.name: EMP Rocket
feats.description: as an action, you can fire a special rocket that deals 2/3/4 dmg + Stuns Robotic targets for 2 turns, 25ft radius.

feats.name: Rupture
feats.description: as an action, gain +10 crit & the target suffers Rupture 3 for the rest of the encounter, uses 3 ammo, 4 turn cooldown.

feats.name: Incinerator
feats.description: +20ft to range & +10ft to cone.

feats.name: Savior
feats.description: all Healing, now heals 4 more HP.

feats.name: Implacable
feats.description: If you get a kill, +15 mov for your turn.

feats.name: Lightning Reflexes
feats.description: you can auto pass a Dex save = to your pro.

feats.name: Close Combat Specialist
feats.description: (Free action) you can make a reaction shot at a target within 20ft that moves or attacks.

feats.name: Untouchable
feats.description: If you get a kill, the next attack against you will miss.

feats.name: Volatile Mix
feats.description: your grenades area gains +5ft.

feats.name: Sentinel
feats.description: in overwatch, you can take 2 reaction shots.

feats.name: Salvo
feats.description: grenades + Heavy weapons are now a bonus action.

feats.name: Killzone
feats.description: take a reaction shot against any enemy that moves or attacks within the cone of fire (60ft cone).

feats.name: Rapid Reaction
feats.description: while in overwatch, each shot you hit, gain another reaction shot, up to your Dex mod.

feats.name: Multitargeting
feats.description: you can now tag targets in a 20/25/30ft radius as a bonus action, 2 turn cooldown.

feats.name: Hunter's Instincts
feats.description: Ranged Attacks +2 dmg on flanked targets.

feats.name: Whirlwind
feats.description: If you hit with a melee attack on your turn, +15ft move.

feats.name: Quickburn
feats.description: Use your "Flame Thrower" as a Free action, 5 turn cooldown.

feats.name: Rescue Protocol
feats.description: As a bonus action, use your Gremlin to grant the target +3 to Dex saves, +10ft movement. It can be used 2/3/4 times per encounter and refreshes movement.

feats.name: Threat Assessment
feats.description: Aid Protocol now also grants a reaction shot.

feats.name: Full Override
feats.description: Make a Hack check to Take Full control of a ADVENT Robot (will go to the closest ally base after combat).

feats.name: Street sweeper
feats.description: as an action, fire in a 15ft cone to deal your weapons dmg with +6 dmg, uses 2 ammo, doesn't work against full cover, 5 turn cooldown if target is unarmored.

feats.name: Chain Lightning
feats.description: as an action with your "Arc Thrower", you attack a target + if it hit chain to another non-robotic target, Up to 5 different targets, 4 turn cooldown.

feats.name: Lethal
feats.description: +2 dmg & +1 crit dmg to your classes weapons.

feats.name: Shock wave
feats.description: your Grenades & rockets make targets suffer -3 AC & -4 Dex save for 1 turn.

feats.name: Coup de Grace
feats.description: +10 to Hit/crit & +2 dmg on disoriented, stunned, or panicking targets.

feats.name: Ghost Grenade
feats.description: you can now make these with smokes, instead of extra AC, you instead get Stealthed.

feats.name: Saturation Fire
feats.description: costs 4 ammo, make an attack at every target in a 60ft cone, 7 turn cooldown, (attack action).

feats.name: Traverse Fire
feats.description: +1 Extra attack.

feats.name: Double Tap
feats.description: After Attacking, you can Attack again or go into Overwatch.

feats.name: Alpha, Mike, Foxtrot
feats.description: +4 dmg & +2 crit dmg.

feats.name: Serial
feats.description: as an action, every kill you get with a Ranged weapon, you can make another attack with a -1 dmg & -4 crit per kill, 7 turn cooldown.

feats.name: Conceal
feats.description: as an action, immediately enter stealth, once a Encounter.

feats.name: Bunker Buster
feats.description: you can fire a building destroying rocket, 50ft radius, (uses all actions).

feats.name: Crusader's Rage
feats.description: +2 dmg per 5 Hp missing.

feats.name: Firestorm
feats.description: Once per Encounter, in a 30ft radius centerd on you, targets take +2dmg + "Flame Thrower" dmg, uses all actions, you are now Fire Immune.

feats.name: Restoration
feats.description: Once per Encounter, you can send your Gremlin to Heal all your allys.

feats.name: Capaciter Discharge
feats.description: once per Encounter, you can send your Gremlin to discharge in a 30ft area, Ignore Armor, cause 1d8/1d12/1d20 dmg, +4dmg to Robotics, Non-Robotic targets get disorienting.
